Class ToastRenderSnapshot

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.toast.ToastRenderSnapshot
public final class ToastRenderSnapshot extends Object
Immutable per-frame render model for painting one toast via ToastWidget.

    • ToastRenderSnapshot

      public ToastRenderSnapshot(String id, ToastType type, String title, List<String> messageLines, double remainingFraction, BorderMode borderMode, TitleLayout titleLayout, TitleSeparator titleSeparator, TitleAlignment titleAlignment, boolean highlightTitle, ProgressStyle progressStyle, Style typeStyle, Style titleStyle, Style messageStyle, Style progressBarStyle)
      Creates a render snapshot with all fields required for one paint pass.
      Parameters:
      id - the toast instance id
      type - the semantic toast type
      title - the optional title, or null
      messageLines - wrapped message lines
      remainingFraction - fraction of lifetime remaining (0..1); ignored for sticky toasts
      borderMode - the border rendering mode
      titleLayout - the title row layout mode
      titleSeparator - the separator between title segments
      titleAlignment - the title row alignment
      highlightTitle - whether the title band is highlighted
      progressStyle - the progress bar visual style
      typeStyle - the resolved style for type accent and borders
      titleStyle - the resolved style for the title band
      messageStyle - the resolved style for message lines
      progressBarStyle - the resolved style for the progress bar

      toast - the toast definition
      lines - wrapped message lines
